signals.name: MFSK16 / MFSK32
signals.description: Three MFSK signals a moment apart: MFSK16 at 700 Hz, MFSK32 at 1500 Hz, MFSK16 at 2300 Hz

signals.name: BPSK31
signals.description: Five BPSK31 signals at once (600, 900, 1250, 1650, 2100 Hz), those at 600 and 1650 Hz after their RSID

signals.name: PSK63, PSK125, QPSK31
signals.description: PSK63 at 600 and 1750 Hz, PSK125 at 1300 and 2250 Hz and QPSK31 at 900 and 2700 Hz, all at once

signals.name: RTTY 45/170
signals.description: Five RTTY signals at once, 45.45 baud 170 Hz shift, centred on 550, 1000, 1450, 1900, 2350 Hz; those at 550 and 1900 Hz after their RSID

signals.name: RTTY 50/75 Baud, 425/850 Hz
signals.description: Four RTTY signals at other bauds and shifts: 50 baud 170 Hz at 600 Hz, 45.45 baud 425 Hz at 1250 Hz, 50 baud 850 Hz at 2100 Hz, 75 baud 170 Hz at 2950 Hz

signals.name: DominoEX / THOR
signals.description: DominoEX and THOR at several speeds, two or three at once: DominoEX 11 at 800 Hz, THOR 16 at 1500 Hz, DominoEX 22 at 2300 Hz, DominoEX 8 at 1150 Hz, THOR 11 at 2000 Hz, DominoEX 16 at 2700 Hz
